> 第二十四章 丹斗（第1页）
在一场初级比赛，能够出现两次紫色丹云，这一点足够让在场的人大吃一惊的，能够在同一场初级比赛之中，出现两次紫色丹云，已经算得上史无前例的。
然而此次的紫色丹云远远地超过了刚刚的那一次，所以众人就更加高兴啦！
正当众人正在惊讶的时候，天空之中出现了闪电，同时雷声传来，众人不由得更加惊讶啦！如果说紫色丹云已经算得上奇观了，那么出现丹雷就绝对是奇观之中的奇观。
此时荼姚等人已经坐不住了，因为就连他们都没有本事能够炼出一颗能够引下丹雷，然而此时比赛之中居然有人能够引下丹雷，这一点就已经是让所有人为之一震啊！
这个人不是其他人就是准备炼制民级丹药的冯斗，他此时炼制的丹药居然能够引下来丹雷，这一点也是连他自己都没有想到的，一旦能引下丹雷，这一下子第一名就已经非他莫属啦！
当冯斗的丹药可能引下丹雷时，最为之高兴的人却是焦伢，因为他基本上已经断定自己已经完胜众人啦！
他不由得露出笑容，因为他马上就有一大笔钱将要进口袋啦！
他笑道：“各位可要准备好银两！”
众人听到这一番话，内心还是觉得非常之不爽的，仿佛他已经赢定啦！
然而正在专心炼药的冯斗并没有太多的心情去理会这些东西，这时已经没有太多时间给冯斗来浪费了，毕竟此时已经出现了两个强有力的竞争对手，他如果能够成功引下丹雷，那就是成功了，否则就是最大的失败。
冯斗此时不断地为药鼎里添加一些小药材，进行调和使得丹药更加快聚成丹药，这样的丹药才能够更加品阶更加高。
荼姚看到了冯斗所控制火候和药材的分量，绝对是一绝，就连她也是自叹不如，一眼就可以看得出冯斗的炼药技术绝非一般，就连控制火候的技术也非常之高超的。
原本就是出身于大家族的荼姚对于冯斗已经产生先除之而后快的想法，但是她不可以暴露出自己的想法。
此时站在一旁，有一个身穿黑色衣服，带着斗笠的人却对身边的人说：“全叔，赶紧让人查清楚这个人底细。”
“小姐，我们出来太久啦！万一给族长大人知道了，我们真的兜不住啊！”
“全叔，出任何事就有我在！你就放心吧！”
全叔听到那个女子的话之后，就直接离开，慢慢地消失在人群之中。
就在此时，天空的丹雷已经形成，闪电不断地翻滚着，然而越来越烈，仿佛随时都可以劈下来一样的。
在场的一些老者都开始议论起来，“丹雷已成，看来一代天赋异禀的天才出现了。”
“所谓的天才能否活着离开这里都是一个未知数啊！”
“除非他身后能够拥有强大的势力，不然他可能难以离开这里啊！”
其他人所想说的并非没有道理的，因为曾经有过不少的人展露出了自己的炼药技术之后，最后反而被一些大家族灭掉。
冯斗此时展露出来的天赋足够让各大家族眼红不已，所以此时的各大势力肯定已经在暗中调查冯斗的身后势力，有些家族想拉拢，当然也有不少的家族准备除掉冯斗的，所以暗流翻涌。
可以说处处有仙机，处处是危险的。根本就不是一个人能够改变得了的，当然这一切都已经超出了冯斗所能够预料之外，所以他也不可能做到万无一失的。
接下来等待他的是什么结果，他也不可预知的。
“啪啦！”一声，一道闪电劈下来，直接打到了冯斗的药鼎中。

> Chapter 24 Dan Dou (Page 1)
In a junior match, purple pill clouds can appear twice, which is enough to surprise everyone present. To have two purple pill clouds appear in the same junior match is unprecedented.
However, the purple pill cloud this time far exceeded the one just now, so everyone was even more happy!
Just when everyone was surprised, lightning appeared in the sky and thunder sounded at the same time. Everyone couldn't help but be even more surprised! If the purple pill cloud can already be considered a spectacle, then the appearance of the pill thunder is definitely a wonder among wonders.
At this time, Tu Yao and others could no longer sit still, because even they did not have the ability to refine a pill that could draw down the pill thunder. However, at this time, someone in the competition could actually draw out the pill thunder. This was already shocking to everyone!
This person is none other than Feng Dou, who is preparing to refine civilian-level elixirs. The elixir he is refining at this time can actually attract elixirs. This is something that even he did not expect. Once he can attract elixirs, he will be the first to win!
When Feng Dou's elixir could trigger the elixir, the happiest person was Jiao Ya, because he had basically concluded that he had completely defeated everyone!
He couldn't help but smile, because he was about to have a lot of money in his pocket!
He smiled and said: "Everyone, please prepare your silver coins!"
When everyone heard these words, they still felt very unhappy inside, as if he had already won!
However, Feng Dou, who was concentrating on refining the medicine, was not in the mood to pay much attention to these things. At this time, there was not much time for Feng Dou to waste. After all, two strong competitors had appeared at this time. If he could successfully induce the Dan Lei, it would be a success, otherwise it would be the biggest failure.
At this time, Feng Dou continued to add some small medicinal materials to the medicine cauldron and mixed them to make the elixirs gather into elixirs faster. Only in this way can the elixirs be of a higher grade.
Tu Yao saw that Feng Dou's ability to control the heat and medicinal materials was absolutely unparalleled. Even she felt inferior. It could be seen at a glance that Feng Dou's medicine refining skills were by no means ordinary, and even the skill of controlling the heat was very superb.
Tu Yao, who originally came from a big family, had already had the idea of ​​​​getting rid of Feng Dou first, but she could not expose her thoughts.
At this time, standing aside, a man wearing black clothes and a bamboo hat said to the people around him: "Uncle Quan, hurry up and let someone find out the details of this person."
"Miss, we have been out for too long! If the patriarch finds out, we really can't hold it back!"
"Uncle Quan, I will be here if anything happens! Don't worry!"
After Uncle Quan heard what the woman said, he left directly and slowly disappeared into the crowd.
At this moment, the Dan Lei in the sky had formed, and the lightning kept rolling, but it became more and more intense, as if it could be struck down at any time.
Some of the old men present began to talk, "Dan Lei has been completed. It seems that a generation of talented geniuses has appeared."
"Whether the so-called genius can leave here alive is unknown!"
"Unless he has a powerful force behind him, it may be difficult for him to leave here!"
What others say is not unreasonable, because there have been many people who showed their medicine refining skills and were eventually killed by some big families.
The talent shown by Feng Dou at this time is enough to make all the major families jealous, so the major forces at this time must have been secretly investigating the forces behind Feng Dou. Some families want to win over him, and of course many families are ready to get rid of Feng Dou, so there is an undercurrent.
It can be said that there are opportunities everywhere and dangers everywhere. It's simply not something that one person can change. Of course, all this is beyond Feng Dou's expectation, so he can't be foolproof.
He couldn't predict what outcome was waiting for him next.
"Crack!" With a sound, a bolt of lightning struck down and hit Feng Dou's medicine cauldron directly.
